name: Mauve Sequin Mermaid Gown
short_description: Hand-sequinned mauve mermaid with a sheer overskirt — a bridal piece for the moment after the ceremony.
description: A sweetheart-neckline mermaid gown in soft mauve, hand-finished with sequins and beadwork across the bodice. A detachable tulle overskirt drops to the floor, and a thigh slit keeps the line modern. Sized to flatter, made to last.

name: Mauve Off-Shoulder Gown
short_description: Off-shoulder mauve sequin gown with a tulle overskirt — the second of our pink wedding pair.
description: An off-shoulder mauve gown with intricate sequinning that catches every light. The detachable tulle overskirt gives the silhouette its drama; the thigh slit gives it its movement.

name: Plum One-Shoulder Gown
short_description: Plum sequin gown with a single sculptural shoulder and a trailing chiffon train.
description: A one-shoulder gown in a rich plum sequin fabric, finished with a flowing chiffon train. Built for ceremonies, receptions, and the photographs that follow.

name: Aqua Sequin Gown
short_description: Soft aqua sequinned gown — strapless, with the same overskirt-and-slit silhouette.
description: Strapless aqua sequinned gown with hand-finished bodice and detachable tulle overskirt. A quieter colour for a bride who wants the dress to speak without shouting.

name: Coral Tulle Bustier Dress
short_description: Layered coral tulle with a structured bustier — a statement piece for engagement parties.
description: A coral tulle bustier dress with sculpted ruffles cascading from the waist. The bustier is hand-finished; the tulle layers give it volume without weight.

name: Cobalt Blue Tulle Gown
short_description: A cobalt tulle gown with cascading ruffles — built for ballrooms and big rooms.
description: Off-shoulder cobalt blue gown in layered tulle, with ruffled detailing running the full length of the skirt. The cut is structured at the bodice and full at the floor — confident, deliberate.

name: Champagne Tulle Ballgown
short_description: Strapless champagne ballgown with sequin detailing — for the bride after the ceremony.
description: Strapless champagne ballgown with sequin and bead detailing flowing through the skirt. The tulle layers are full but light; the bodice is structured to hold its shape across a long evening.

name: Maroon Rosette Gown
short_description: Ruched maroon satin with a hand-sculpted rosette at the waist.
description: Strapless maroon satin gown with deep ruching across the bodice and a hand-sculpted rosette feature at the waist. The skirt opens at the thigh; the train trails behind.

name: Champagne Satin Beaded Gown
short_description: Bias-cut champagne satin with a fully beaded bodice — a quiet, expensive look.
description: Cap-sleeve champagne satin gown with a beaded bodice and a fluid bias-cut skirt. Designed to read sculptural in photographs and feel like nothing in person.

name: Sage Satin Gown
short_description: Strapless sage satin with a beaded bodice — the most accessibly-priced piece in the collection.
description: Strapless sage satin gown with a beaded bodice and a clean, full skirt. The most accessibly-priced piece in our current collection — equally at home at receptions, evening events, and the moments in between.
